summary: Backend API regression and live GPT nutrition estimate passed; public browser preview was unavailable during UI testing.

integration_issues.issue: Public preview displayed Preview Unavailable, preventing Playwright verification of meal entry, save/delete, navigation, and responsive layout.

action_items: Restore/wake the public preview and rerun the complete Playwright dashboard flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend UI and backend implementation appear aligned by inspection; browser verification remains outstanding due to unavailable preview.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_ meal dated 2099-01-01; no persistent seed data remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API root, meal create/list/delete, invalid segment validation, and live GPT estimate shape passed. Public URL showed hosting Preview Unavailable before UI selectors rendered.
rca of the issue: The browser reached the preview host but received its inactivity/unavailable interstitial instead of the React app. This blocked E2E UI testing; no application-level UI failure was established.
